jobs.prompt: Correct this original male TWO-panel 45-degree sled CALF PRESS. Remove ALL red from chest and shirt, shirt fully BLACK opaque. Red ONLY exposed posterior CALVES. Essential correction: move BOTH FEET DOWN to very LOWER EDGE of footplate in both cells, ONLY balls of feet/forefeet supported on plate lip, heels protrude BELOW AND BEYOND lower lip with clear airspace, NOT full soles on plate. LEFT ankles dorsiflexed heels lowered toward body, RIGHT plantarflexed heels pushed away from body by ankle extension, toe balls maintain contact on lower lip. Keep knees same nearly straight angle, hip/head/back fixed pad, no knee extension change. Machine rails45degrees, footplate attached carriage moves only small ankle-driven distance. Show clear ankle angle change. Both hands grip side seat handles. Preserve full opaque black shirt/shorts front sides back seat crotch, detailed exposed grayscale anatomy, white background. TWO equal square landscape cells, generous margins no clipping. No text.
